text: たのむよ　かたせて　くれよお

structure.jp: かたせて　くれよお

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かたせる turns 'win' into 'let someone win'. かたせて = 'letting me win'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form verb is a blunt, manly way to ask someone to do something for you. かたせて　くれ = 'let me win'.
